#Boston Dog Photography Class
##*Capture portraits and action shots of your dog*

• **Adults:** $55
• **Youth (10-17):** $20
_________________________

If you’ve ever wanted to take pictures of your beloved dog that stand out, this PhotoWalks class is designed to show you the scenic locations in Beacon Hill and the Charles River Esplanade for the best shots.

Bring your smartphone or camera and learn how to:

*Pose your dog for portraits
*Capture playful action shots
*Take pictures that express your dog’s personality
*Use settings on your smartphone or camera to nail that shot!

Space is limited to 8. (One dog per person per reservation.)

Meeting Point: On the corner of Charles + Chestnut St.–outside Beacon Hill Hotel
